justify: S603 per-file-ignore: GitIgnores runs a fixed git argv (rev-parse, check-ignore) so the secret guard honours every ignore source git does; no shell, no caller-built program name -- the same allowance every other subprocess module in src has

Lazy sounddevice import for the optional call extra (PortAudio dependency) -- matches 6 existing precedents in this pyproject.toml for optional heavy providers; a hard top-level import would break every vox invocation on a host without PortAudio.
